name: Jenni Perry
title: Senior communications strategist and PR consultant
bio_short: Senior communications strategist with more than 20 years' experience. Former press secretary to the Royal Household and UK head of PR at Pfizer. Specialises in strategic communications, crisis management, media training and public affairs.
bio: Jenni is a senior communications strategist and PR consultant with more than 20 years' experience across the UK Government, the Royal Household and the global pharmaceutical industry. She served as a press secretary at St James's Palace, advising and accompanying members of the Royal Family on visits and public engagements, and represented the Palace at press office meetings at Buckingham Palace.  Jenni began her career in the UK Government Information and Communication Service, working in the Department of Trade and Industry and the Department of Health, before passing the Senior Information Officer promotion board and being seconded to the Royal Household. In the corporate sector, she was UK head of public relations for Pfizer, where as a member of the European communications team she managed PR and media training across the organisation.  At ISOC, Jenni delivers programmes in corporate communications, crisis communication, media training and public affairs. She has managed media training at European conferences including the European Society of Cardiologists, and her advisory roles span the Royal Hospital Chelsea and NHS trust boards. Her career spanning government, royal and corporate communications gives her a rare breadth of perspective. Jenni is based in the UK and trains in English.

She served as a press secretary at St James's Palace, advising and accompanying members of the Royal Family on visits and public engagements, and represented the Palace at press office meetings at Buckingham Palace. Her duties included overseeing communications for the Duchy Originals brand and supporting communications with the Prince's Trust and charity patronages.  Jenni began her career in the UK Government Information and Communication Service, working in the Department of Trade and Industry and the Department of Health, before passing the Senior Information Officer promotion board and being seconded to the Royal Household. In the corporate sector, she was UK head of public relations for Pfizer, where as a member of the European communications team she managed PR and media training across the organisation in one of the world's most heavily regulated and scrutinised industries.  At ISOC, Jenni delivers programmes in corporate communications, crisis communication, media training, public affairs and speechwriting. She has managed media training at major European conferences including the European Society of Cardiologists in London, Rome, Barcelona and Munich. Her advisory roles have included the Royal Hospital Chelsea, NHS trust boards and a significant change management project in the health sector. She is also an experienced executive coach who works with CEOs and leadership teams on communication strategy. Her career spanning government, royal and corporate communications gives her a rare combination of perspectives on how reputational decisions are made at the highest levels. Jenni is based in the UK and trains in English.
